description: Traffic Volumes - Midblock Vehicle Speed, Volume and Classification Counts is a dataset listed in City of Toronto open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by City of Toronto. The City of Toronto's Transportation Services Division collects short-term traffic count data across the City on an ad-hoc basis to support a variety of safety initiatives and projects. The data available in this repository are a full collection of Speed, Volume and Classification Counts conducted across the City since 1993. Coverage: Toronto. The portal files it under the publisher City of Toronto. Its tags are atr, traffic-speed, traffic-volume, truck-volume, vehicle-classification. It offers 30 resource(s) in CSV, JSON, PNG, XLSX, XML. The portal shows 2026-09-30 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-toronto-portal.
